role: Exploratory geometry and identifiability calculation, followed by a conditional propagation comparison; not a Cassini likelihood refit
hypotheses: Linear response about Minkowski spacetime, conserved sources, weak fields and universal metric readout
One nonnegative massless spin-2 residue Z and nonnegative massive spin-2/spin-0 measures on inverse Compton lengths mu >= 0
No nonlinear screening or environmental change of the spectral measures in this first family
Static spherical source with nonnegative density, linear Born ray propagation outside it
Frequency-domain radiative branch k(mu,omega)=sqrt((omega/c)^2-mu^2), with retarded boundary condition
A propagation timing comparison concerns the identified observed carrier, not every unobserved mode
normalization: Phi=-Gstar*M/r [Z+(4/3)int F(mu)exp(-mu*r)dW2+2int F(mu)exp(-mu*r)dW0]; Psi=-Gstar*M/r [Z+(2/3)int F exp(-mu*r)dW2-2int F exp(-mu*r)dW0]

benchmark_geometry.geometry_status: Declared idealization motivated by Cassini conjunction; fixed endpoint z and one circular reference orbit, not reconstructed Cassini ephemeris
source_profiles: arbitrary nonnegative spherical density support <= R

candidate_families.G1: Z=0, W0=0, one positive massive spin-2 pole; choose mu only by benchmark light/force ratio matching, not GW timing
candidate_families.G2: Z>=0 plus positive finite-support spectral measures; derive allowed envelopes and unresolved modes rather than choose independently fitted sector values

selection_exposure: Cassini near-unity gamma and GW170817/GRB timing results were known before this contract. Any comparison is model-development compatibility, never a blind prediction.
calibration_rule: For G1 solve 2*light_gradient_kernel(mu,b0)/((4/3)*force_kernel(mu,r0))-1=1 at b0=1.6 R. This is an idealized GR-shaped response equality, not a fit of the observed Cassini gamma parameter.
test_quantities: Light-path response shape across the other declared b values, without refitting mu
Relative acceleration response at 0.387, 0.723, 1.524 reference-orbit radii, as future observable targets and not scored observations
Group delay at 30, 100, 300 and 1000 Hz over declared 26 Mpc, compared conditionally to the primary timing/intrinsic-delay interval once extraction is pinned
free_parameters_and_nuisance: Overall Gstar*M calibrated by one force radius; mu fixed by the benchmark ratio for G1. Source density profile cancels from G1 light/force ratio for the same spherical source. Real ephemerides, ray endpoints, Doppler nuisance design/covariance, gamma emission lag, source waveform and massive-mode detector coupling remain separate.
verification: Compare analytic exterior sphere factor against direct source quadrature; compare finite ray gradient against quadrature and Bessel infinite-ray limit; inspect small/large-mu limits; independent derivation before load-bearing reuse.
claim_limit: No general-gravity exclusion, observed GW massive-mode fraction bound, measured Cassini fit, nonlinear completion or TOE claim is authorized by this calculation. No adopted premise or audit status changes.
